rules.statement: A co-owner is not entitled to build or make other improvements on the common property after the institution of a partition action, unless such actions are necessary repairs.
rules.supporting_quote: Of course a co-owner would be acting within his rights if he effects necessary repairs to a building even after the institution of partition proceedings. If a co-owner is permitted to build or plant the common property even after the institution of the partition action it might result in other co-owners having to pay compensation for improvements which they do not wish to have.
